why: The review page's theme button is named by its action, 'Toggle theme' (aria-label), while it shows the theme in force ('Warm · oxblood'): a speech-input user who says the words on it does not reach it (WCAG 2.5.3). Renaming it changes the name src/pages/Review.test.tsx finds it by, which this ticket does not touch.
followUp: ADR-0094 L3 strengthening, accessibility acceptance: name it 'Theme: <theme in force>' and find it by that name in Review.test.tsx; then remove this entry.
